content_of_post_to_comment: Does anyone have statistics showing how many people take road trips in America from east to west versus west to east? I’m betting the first is much greater. Manifest Destiny and all that. I would be fascinated.
comment: The interesting wrinkle is that westbound trips often end in a new life, while eastbound ones can be a return to one. I wonder whether migration history shaped the mythology more than actual road-trip numbers.
